map_state: Existing local user-modified map; not saved or modified by this investigation.
issue: Circular discontinuities on the ColorBox white sphere, caused primarily by hard receiver-hemisphere probe rejection.

change.scope: Activate the already implemented positive-hemisphere smoothstep path by default in plugin C++ and host project configuration.
change.behind_surface_probes: Still rejected; no nonzero weight floor or across-wall fallback was added.
change.not_claimed: Not a port of full RTXGI wrap weighting, GIBS, SurfelPlus or Split Radiance Cascades.

research.title: Shipping Dynamic Global Illumination in Frostbite
research.type: SIGGRAPH Advances presentation, Diede Apers / EA Frostbite
research.finding: Probe reconstruction uses DDGI-like software interpolation and variance-depth attenuation; surfel surface normals and numerical ray offsets are separate concerns.
research.decision: Keep visibility independent of the receiver-hemisphere transition. Do not disable occlusion to hide the rings.

research.title: SurfelPlus: A Surfel-Based Global Illumination Solution Optimized for Low-End Graphics Hardware
research.finding: Describes surfel lifecycle, a combined generation/shading pass, temporal aggregation, and filtered reflections.
research.decision: It does not establish a specific fix for hard probe hemisphere boundaries in this SH-volume renderer.

research.title: Split Radiance Cascades: Real-Time Global Illumination via Sparse Radiance Probes
research.finding: Sparse world-space cascades and ray splitting address spatial/angular detail; the limitations still acknowledge interpolation bias and sub-probe-scale leaks.
research.decision: Potential future architecture work, not a drop-in correction for this reproducible discontinuity. No claim to exhaustively cover all 2026 literature.

research.title: Scaling Probe-Based Real-Time Dynamic Global Illumination for Production
research.type: Published DDGI production work; arXiv first submission 2020
research.finding: The public implementation explains loss of usable probes under naive backface tests and uses continuous wrap weights with separate visibility.
research.decision: Use the continuity principle, but preserve the current positive-hemisphere rejection and first-hit planes. Existing smoothstep implementation suffices for the observed rings.

metric_definition.continuity: Absolute 4-neighbor discrete Laplacian of linear luminance: abs(L_left+L_right+L_up+L_down-4*L_center). Percentiles exclude the ROI one-pixel border.
metric_definition.interpretation: Artifact-sensitive local continuity diagnostic, NOT a standard perceptual quality score or a reduction of error against physical ground truth.
metric_definition.baseline_vs_candidate: Differences between the old and new render, NOT errors against a path-traced reference.
metric_definition.samples: One completed HDR capture per configuration; no statistical significance claim.

planar_regression.mode: Indirect-only paired PNG captures, transition 0 versus 0.2
planar_regression.observations: Visual inspection of ClassicBox, ShinyBox and the interior overview found no new obvious planar rings or through-wall leaks. Existing capture and SH limitations remain.
planar_regression.color_box_flat_regions: Left-wall mean luminance changed approximately -1.05%, back wall +0.13%; local p99 Laplacian remained unchanged to rounding.
